result:
I’d make it so people everywhere could easily verify the truth of what they’re being told—especially in politics, news, and science.

Concretely: strong, universal provenance for information (who made it, when, from what source, and whether it’s been altered), plus tools that make misinformation and deepfakes far harder to spread and easier to detect. If truth became “default” instead of something you have to fight for, most other problems—polarization, corruption, unsafe public decisions—would get dramatically easier to solve.
